scenario: Six clinic appointments—Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday—are scheduled across a single week. Each appointment is assigned to either the morning session or the afternoon session. Morning sessions are held before 12:00 PM, and afternoon sessions are held after 12:00 PM. The appointments must follow these constraints regarding their day and session assignment.

rules.note: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are all scheduled in the morning.
Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday are all scheduled in the afternoon.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following correctly pairs each day with its session assignment?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Monday—morning, Tuesday—morning, Wednesday—afternoon, Thursday—afternoon, Friday—morning, Saturday—afternoon

choices.label: B
choices.text: Monday—morning, Tuesday—afternoon, Wednesday—morning, Thursday—afternoon, Friday—morning, Saturday—afternoon

choices.label: C
choices.text: Monday—afternoon, Tuesday—afternoon, Wednesday—morning, Thursday—morning, Friday—afternoon, Saturday—morning

choices.label: D
choices.text: Monday—morning, Tuesday—afternoon, Wednesday—afternoon, Thursday—morning, Friday—morning, Saturday—afternoon

choices.label: E
choices.text: Monday—afternoon, Tuesday—morning, Wednesday—morning, Thursday—afternoon, Friday—afternoon, Saturday—morning

explanations.correct: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday must all be in the morning, and Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday must all be in the afternoon. Choice B satisfies both constraints.
explanations.A: Wednesday is assigned to the afternoon, but it must be in the morning. Violates the rule that Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are all morning appointments.
explanations.B: Correct. Monday, Wednesday, Friday are morning; Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday are afternoon.
explanations.C: Monday is assigned to the afternoon, but it must be in the morning. Violates the constraint that Monday is a morning appointment.
explanations.D: Wednesday is assigned to the afternoon, but it must be in the morning. Violates the rule that all of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday must be morning appointments.
explanations.E: Monday and Friday are assigned to afternoon and afternoon respectively, but they must both be morning. Violates the constraint that Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are all morning appointments.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Wednesday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Thursday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Tuesday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Friday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Saturday is scheduled in the morning.

explanations.correct: The rules explicitly state that Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are all scheduled in the morning. Therefore, Wednesday must be in the morning.
explanations.A: Correct. Wednesday is part of the group {Monday, Wednesday, Friday} that must all be scheduled in the morning.
explanations.B: Thursday is part of the group {Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday} that must all be scheduled in the afternoon, not the morning.
explanations.C: While Tuesday is indeed in the afternoon, this is not the only must-be-true statement. However, this statement is also true. The primary answer is A because it is explicitly mandated.
explanations.D: Friday must be scheduled in the morning, not the afternoon. This contradicts the stated rules.
explanations.E: Saturday must be scheduled in the afternoon, not the morning. This contradicts the stated rules.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Monday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Tuesday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: C
choices.text: All six appointments are scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Friday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Wednesday is scheduled in the morning.

explanations.correct: Wednesday is one of the days {Monday, Wednesday, Friday} that must be scheduled in the morning. Therefore, it could (and must) be true that Wednesday is in the morning.
explanations.A: Monday must be in the morning session. It cannot be in the afternoon.
explanations.B: Tuesday is part of the group {Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday} that must all be in the afternoon. It cannot be in the morning.
explanations.C: Saturday must be in the afternoon. Therefore, it is impossible for all six appointments to be in the morning.
explanations.D: Friday is part of the group {Monday, Wednesday, Friday} that must all be in the morning. It cannot be in the afternoon.
explanations.E: Correct. Wednesday must be in the morning, so this could (and must) be true.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tuesday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Friday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Monday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Wednesday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Saturday is scheduled in the afternoon.

explanations.correct: Monday must be scheduled in the morning according to the rules. Therefore, Monday being scheduled in the afternoon cannot be true.
explanations.A: Tuesday is part of {Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday} which must all be in the afternoon, so this is true.
explanations.B: Friday is part of {Monday, Wednesday, Friday} which must all be in the morning, so this is true.
explanations.C: Correct. Monday must be in the morning, so it cannot be in the afternoon.
explanations.D: Wednesday must be in the morning, so this is true.
explanations.E: Saturday must be in the afternoon, so this is true.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be false?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Monday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Tuesday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Friday is scheduled in the morning.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Wednesday is scheduled in the afternoon.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Thursday is scheduled in the afternoon.

explanations.correct: Tuesday is part of the group {Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday} that must all be scheduled in the afternoon. Therefore, the statement 'Tuesday is scheduled in the morning' must be false.
explanations.A: Monday must be in the morning, so this statement is true, not false.
explanations.B: Correct. Tuesday must be in the afternoon, so the claim that Tuesday is in the morning must be false.
explanations.C: Friday must be in the morning, so this statement is true, not false.
explanations.D: Wednesday must be in the morning, so the claim that it is in the afternoon is false. However, B is the primary answer.
explanations.E: Thursday must be in the afternoon, so this statement is true, not false.
